guesses.breed: Domestic Shorthair (gray and white / blue bicolor)
guesses.reason: A short, dense solid gray coat with a white chest locket, white belly spot, and white-tipped paws is the classic random-bred blue-and-white pattern.
The plush blue-gray coat and large upright ears suggest it, but the white markings rule out a purebred Russian Blue.
The solid blue-gray coloring resembles a Chartreux, though the slender kitten build and white patches point to a mix.

breed.appearance: A young kitten with a short, soft, solid blue-gray coat, a white bib on the chest, a small white patch on the belly, and white mittens on the front paws. It has large, upright, pointed ears with pink inner skin, round blue-gray kitten eyes, a gray nose, and long white whiskers. Its build is small and slender with a wedge-shaped face, and it sits upright looking curiously at the viewer.
breed.fun_fact: Gray-and-white domestic shorthairs are healthy, adaptable all-rounders, so Carter could be just as happy cuddling on the couch as chasing toys across the floor!
